target.title: fix(plugins): stage git plugin clone on target filesystem to avoid EXDEV
target.body:
## Summary

- Stage the transient `git:` plugin clone under the managed git root (same filesystem as the destination) instead of `os.tmpdir()`.
- Fixes `EXDEV: cross-device link not permitted` when installing git plugins in containers where `/tmp` and `~/.openclaw` are separate mounts.

## What Problem This Solves

`openclaw plugins install git:<repo>` clones into `os.tmpdir()`, then does an atomic `fs.rename()` of the staged repo into `~/.openclaw/git/`. When those two paths are on different filesystems (common in Docker with bind-mounted state dirs — btrfs, NFS, overlay vs bind mount), the rename fails with `EXDEV: cross-device link not permitted` and the install aborts. Closes #99885.

This takes the issue's suggested alternative: stage on the same filesystem as the target so the rename is always intra-device. `withTempDir` gains an optional `rootDir`, and `installPluginFromGitSpec` stages under the managed git root (parent of `git-<hash>/repo`). If that root can't be prepared, it falls back to `os.tmpdir()`, preserving prior behavior rather than failing the install.

## Evidence

- `npx vitest run src/plugins/git-install.test.ts` — 21 passed (incl. new test asserting the clone destination lives under the managed git dir)
- `npx vitest run src/infra/install-source-utils.test.ts` — 16 passed
- `npx tsc --noEmit` — clean for touched files
- Did NOT change: the `replaceDirectoryAtomic` primitive itself (lives in `@openclaw/fs-safe`); this fix keeps the rename intra-device instead of adding a copy fallback there.


## Real behavior proof (cross-filesystem rename)

Reproduced the exact `EXDEV` failure and the fix on two genuinely distinct
filesystems (managed git root on a separate APFS volume; `os.tmpdir()` on the
main volume — confirmed distinct `st_dev`), exercising the same
stage-then-`fs.rename()` path `replaceDirectoryAtomic` uses:

```
--- device ids (stat -f dev) ---
dev=16777233 /tmp
dev=16777246 <managed-git-root>   # separate volume

os.tmpdir()      = <redacted>/.openclaw/tmp
managed git root = <redacted-volume>/openclaw-git-root

OLD behavior (stage under os.tmpdir(), rename cross-device):
  [old] rename FAILED: EXDEV: cross-device link not permitted,
        rename '<tmp>/openclaw-git-plugin-XXXX/repo' -> '<git-root>/git-demo/repo'

NEW behavior (stage under managed git root, intra-device rename):
  [new] rename OK -> <git-root>/git-demo/repo (isDir=true)
```

This confirms: with the pre-fix staging location the atomic rename raises
`EXDEV` across mounts (the reported container failure), and staging under the
managed git root makes the rename intra-device so the install succeeds.
